我们突然产生了一种加速感，感知被难以理解的信息洪流淹没。我们不受控地向无尽的地平线冲去。

texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.

An entity moves in tandem with us. This Restless Presence lingers briefly before its velocity propels it beyond the limits of our understanding.

We must follow it.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为不息之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Restless Presence.

texts.zh:
只有当我们强行超越虚境的舒适极限时才终于接触到了不息之物。

一种全向运动的感觉以不合逻辑、无法通过任何度规加以理解的速度感摧垮了我们。我们产生了一种在极短的瞬间横跨了遥远距离的感觉。

我们终于理解了幽黑之长河和它的无尽旅程。星系的浩瀚正为我们开辟了一条道路。
texts.en:
Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the Shroud could we finally reach the Restless Presence.

A sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied all standard comprehensions. We were left with the impression of having travelled a great distance in the briefest moment.

Finally we understood the Black River and its ceaseless journey. The galaxy's vastness is an open path for us to take.

summary.text:
# 幽黑之长河 / Black River

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/inline_scripts/shroud/minor_patron_first_contact_end_event.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 次要赞助者“幽黑之长河”的首次接触事件“虚境中的低语”（shroud.4120），由代码在虚境中自然发现时触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1574），或经“虚境触及者”选项触发（须已接触全部主要赞助者）。  
  First-contact event "Whispers in the Shroud" (shroud.4120) of the minor patron "Black River", launched by the game on natural discovery in the Shroud (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1574) or by the Shroud-touched option (all major patrons must be contacted first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4120：单一选项“尝试沟通”按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版接触项目（events/shroud_events.txt:8890，inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start_event）。  
  shroud.4120: the single option enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8890, inline script minor_patron_first_contact_start_event).
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4125。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4125 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4125仅一个选项，把接触状态记为completed，并获得每月佐罗(Zro)产出。  
  shroud.4125 has a single option that sets the first-contact state to completed and grants monthly Zro output.
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无其他差异。  
  No other variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt与inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared %s, %s and the minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根并添加审阅连接。 项目标题使用游戏内的“未接触前代号”（如“Fathomless Being”），本故事标题使用赞助者名称。  
  The start event is the root, with reviewed bridges. Project titles use the in-game pre-contact code names (e.g. Fathomless Being); the story title uses the patron name.
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部5个文档（含机械/蜂巢版项目）。 / All 5 docs (including robot/hive project versions).
